title: Deal or Force Mod Manifest
description: Root manifest.json declaring a Deal or Force data mod, balance patch, reskin, total conversion, or code extension.

id.description: Unique lowercase mod identifier (1-64 characters: letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens).

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the launcher and Mod Manager.

version.description: Semantic version string for this mod (e.g. '1.0.0').

enabled.description: Whether the mod is enabled by default when discovered.

load_order.description: Numeric priority used to order independent mods; higher values load later and win conflicts.

dependencies.description: List of mod IDs that must load before this mod.

total_conversion.description: When true, suppresses default base-2024 narrative/era roots (events, technologies, decisions, history diplomacy/conflicts/factions) unless replace_paths overrides the list.

replace_paths.description: Virtual game/ category roots cleanly suppressed from the base game before loading this mod's files.

exclude_paths.description: Specific relative base-game files to omit (e.g. 'events/20_ukraine.json').

scenario_id.description: Optional scenario ID associated with this package.

era_name.description: Optional display era name shown in the campaign date plate.

music_playlist.description: Optional soundtrack playlist ID for this mod.

calendar.description: Custom display calendar profile (separated from internal Gregorian simulation dates).

era_name.description: Display era name (e.g. 'Age of Iron', 'Third Sun').

year_offset.description: Offset added to the Gregorian simulation year for display.

year_suffix.description: Suffix after the displayed year (e.g. ' AD', ' BCE', ' AE').

disabled_features.description: Feature IDs or aliases (e.g. 'nukes', 'missiles', 'modern_air_force', 'aviation', 'drones') marked unavailable in this mod.

gdscript_entry.description: Optional GDScript entrypoint relative to the mod folder.

engine_script_entry.description: Optional Luau script entrypoint relative to the mod folder.

defaultSnippets.label: Data / Balance Mod Manifest
defaultSnippets.description: Minimal manifest for a JSON overlay or patch mod

defaultSnippets.label: Total Conversion Manifest
defaultSnippets.description: Manifest for a historical, sci-fi, or fantasy total conversion
